credits_cram.why: Describes CRAM as what \citet{hoover2026classical} 'introduced' and calls its own work a 're-implementation' of that method, never as a new contribution.

cites_hoover.why: Uses \citet{hoover2026classical} repeatedly in the abstract, introduction, methods and results.

small_n.why: Limitations: 'direct LLM solving was measured on a subset of 5--10 puzzles per model.'

handset_caveat.why: Reports the hand-set energy achieved 497/500 and 'matches or marginally exceeds the learned CRAM model' (496-497).

their_numbers.why: The 99.996% and 42 ms H200 figures are attributed to Hoover et al. ('reported'), and the paper's own results are separate. A limitations line wrongly says the replication reproduces '~99.9%'.

no_new_claims.why: Adds details absent from the log: exact prompt texts, sandboxing and syntax checks, an annealing schedule, quasi-Newton optimisation, 'cyclic backtracking loops', row/box duplicate analysis, and the authors' 'private codebase'.
